visual_identity.core_identity: A ceiling-dwelling ambush creature that resembles a leathery stalactite-clinging mantle until it peels away and drops.
visual_identity.silhouette: Flattened manta-like leathery body with broad mantle edges and several short dangling tentacles beneath.
visual_identity.head_features: Small central underside head or beak-like mouth largely hidden beneath the mantle.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact central body under a wide flexible mantle with short gripping tentacles.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No humanoid limbs; short gripping tentacles hang beneath a broad mantle body. Ceiling contact must visibly support resting poses.
visual_identity.surface: Leathery membrane with sparse folds and simple underside texture.

known_failure_modes.correction: remove ears and bat body; restore broad mantle and short underside tentacles
keep a compact mantle body with only short gripping tentacles

known_failure_modes.symptom: resting creature hangs with no ceiling contact
known_failure_modes.correction: show clear attachment to overhead rock or supported flying posture

scene_identity.size_impression: Small compact ceiling predator whose broad mantle is wider than its central body.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Clinging directly to overhead rock or peeling away with support/contact still visually understandable.
behavior_style: dropping from a visible overhead support
